newsitem.title: USA: American Stores sets $300 mln bond offer.
newsitem.headline: American Stores sets $300 mln bond offer.

text.p: American Stores Co it priced a public offering of $100 million of 7.90 percent debentures due May 1, 2017 at 99.961 percent and $200 million of 7.50 percent debentures due May 1, 2037 at 99.712 percent.
The $200 million, 40-year debentures were redeemable on May 1, 2009, the company said.

The $100 million, 20-year issue was priced at a spread of 85 basis points above the 30-year Treasury bond and the $200 million, 40-year issue was priced at a spread of 75 basis points above the 10-year Treasury note, it said.
Underwriters for the debentures were JP Morgan, Chase Securities Inc, Morgan Stanley and Salomon Brothers Inc, the company said.

Net proceeds of the offering would be used to refinance short-term variable rate borrowings under the company's principal bank credit agreement and for general corporate purposes, American Stores said.
American Stores Company is one of the nation's largest food and drug retailers.
